name: Infiltrate can be cancelled at will and still ends when attacked (#4777)
contract: Infiltrate (802281) tooltip: 'Take on the form of the target enemy Undead or Demon. Lasts $d, or until you mount up or deal or receive damage.' Its DurationIndex is -1 (permanent), so the only ways out are mounting, taking/dealing damage, or a manual CMSG_CANCEL_AURA. Effect[0] is a cast-time SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY targeting the enemy being copied (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY), and SpellInfo::_IsPositiveEffect treats that enemy-targeted effect as negative regardless of it applying no aura; that taints SpellInfo::IsPositive() for the whole spell, so WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode (`!spellInfo->IsPositive()`) refused to let the player cancel their own disguise buff (effect 1, the self APPLY_AURA, is the only effect that is actually applied). The fix marks effect 1 positive without touching effect 0, mirroring the Pressure fix (#4422); taking damage already ends the disguise natively via the existing AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE/DIRECT_DAMAGE on this spell.
